column1: The annual average exchange rates for various foreign currencies (either currently or historically published) expressed as one unit of the foreign currency converted into Canadian dollars. These rates are typically published on the last business day of each year by 12:30 (ET). All Bank of Canada exchange rates are indicative rates only, obtained from averages of aggregated price quotes from financial institutions.
